# ITU AI Readiness 2.0 mapping (generated by scripts/gen_ai_readiness_map.py -- do not edit)

Framework: **2.0** — ITU AI Ready - Analysis Towards a Standardized Readiness Framework, Report 2.0, January 2026

Every dimension id, name, short name and factor below is read at generation time from
`data/sources/INTL/02_ITU_AI_Readiness_dimensions.json`, ITU's own file (provenance: `data/sources/INTL/PROVENANCE.md`). The **claim** column is ours and is the only authored text in the table.

All 13 dimensions are accounted for: 9 claimed (5 primary), 4 explicitly not addressed.

| `research` | Research |
| `deployment` | Deployment Support |

## Dimensions we address

| D | ITU dimension | Factors | Metrics | Rank | Our claim | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **D3** | Cross-Domain Correlation Analysis (`cross_domain`) | data, standards | 7 | primary | One rulebook spans telecom, disaster management, cyber incident reporting and data protection, so a conflict between two regimes surfaces as a verdict rather than being filed under a different ministry. | `data/clauses/clauses.jsonl, docs/kb_report.md` |
| **D4** | Contextualization and Regional Impact (`contextualization`) | data, research, deployment | 9 | primary | Contextualised to the actual region and event: real IMD Amphan timings, the real warned districts of Odisha and West Bengal, Khulna across the border, and alerts that only count when they are in that district's own language. | `data/scenarios/amphan_2020.yaml, chakravyuh/fuzz/properties.py (P3)` |
| **D8** | Collaboration with AI (`collaboration`) | opensource, standards | 7 | primary | Agents only propose; deterministic code decides. Irreversible actions return NEEDS_HUMAN and wait at a gate that records whether the approval was a human's or the batch timer's, per ITU-T Y.3173. | `chakravyuh/sim/game_master.py (HumanGate), chakravyuh/policy/engine.py` |
| **D10** | AI & Policies (`ai_policies`) | sandbox, deployment | 10 | primary | The whole system is a policy simulator: three jurisdictions' instruments are compiled into executable packs and the same cyclone is replayed under each, so a policy's effect is measured rather than argued. | `data/packs/*.yaml, chakravyuh/policy/engine.py, outputs/comparison.json` |
| **D11** | AI for Inclusion (`ai_inclusion`) | sandbox | 13 | primary | Inclusion is scored, not asserted: P3 fails if an affected district is alerted only in English, and each CAP envelope's info/language is the district's own language tag (or-IN, bn-IN, bn-BD across the border). | `chakravyuh/alerts/cap.py, chakravyuh/fuzz/properties.py (P3)` |
| **D1** | Data/Model Marketplace (`data_marketplace`) | data, opensource | 13 | secondary | The clause store is a reusable artefact in its own right: one record per clause with verbatim text, SHA-256, page and source URL, which is the metadata ITU's reference ingest does not record. | `data/clauses/clauses.jsonl, docs/kb_report.md` |
| **D2** | Generated Content Marketplace (`generated_content`) | data, opensource | 5 | secondary | Generated content is handled as an adversary, not a feature: the rumour and the forged suspension order are labelled synthetic in the scenario and the forged order is what property P2 exists to catch. | `data/scenarios/amphan_2020.yaml, chakravyuh/fuzz/properties.py (P2)` |
| **D6** | Human Interface (`human_interface`) | standards, deployment | 6 | secondary | The human interface is the audit trail: every action in the UI opens to the reasoning, the rule, the clause text, its hash and its gazette URL. | `app/streamlit_app.py, outputs/audit_sample.jsonl` |
| **D13** | Digital Infrastructure (`digital_infrastructure`) | deployment | 9 | secondary | Site power is modelled as the thing that sets outage duration -- battery drain runs only while mains power is actually lost -- and the register carries the finding that no instrument states a numeric backup requirement. | `chakravyuh/world/dynamics.py, outputs/gap_register.csv (G5)` |

## Dimensions we do not address, and why

| D | ITU dimension | Why not |
|---|---|---|
| D5 | Level of Integration of AI in Workflows (`ai_integration`) | Measures AI's integration into an organisation's workflows. This is a simulator, not a deployment inside a telecom operator or regulator, so there is no workflow to measure. |
| D7 | Strategy Alignment (`strategy_alignment`) | Measures alignment with a national AI strategy. We encode telecom and disaster law, not AI strategy documents, and we hold no text for India's AI strategy. |
| D9 | Impacts of Humans in AI Integration (`human_impact`) | Measures the effect of AI integration on people in an organisation. Out of scope: no human subject is involved anywhere in this system. |
| D12 | Granular Priorities (`granular_priorities`) | Measures how granularly national priorities are expressed. Not something a simulator can evidence. |

## One correction worth recording

An earlier draft of our own proposal described dimension D1 as *Open Source*. ITU's file
says `"id": 1, "name": "Data/Model Marketplace"`; open source is a **factor**
(`opensource`), which several dimensions map to. Reading the labels from the file instead
of retyping them is what caught it, and is why this document has no hand-typed ITU label
in it at all.
